payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precomputes prefix sums and 2D arrays (rdp1, rdp2) to capture interval properties for longest non-decreasing subsequences, then uses a 1D DP to combine results of all possible reversals.
payload.rationale: The solution builds two n x n tables storing computed values for every interval [l, r], which is the dominant computational structure. These tables are used to feed a 1D DP that finds the optimal reversal. This aligns with dp_2d_state, where the state is defined by two indices.
